symbols.name: PhotoField
symbols.sig: export function PhotoField({ id, state, onPick, onRemove, disabled = false }: PhotoFieldProps)

params.name: { id, state, onPick, onRemove, disabled = false }

behaviours: empty: 'Photo (optional)', the format in words (coloured, high-resolution, passport-size; JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP; 8 MB; 400 x 400), a Choose button, 'or drop it here'
the hidden file box takes only JPEG, PNG and WebP and carries the id the panel looks for
checking: says so, names the file, shows a spinner, and offers no button
ready: the picture, 'Face found · made square', that it is on the ID card and saved with the employee, Replace and Remove
saved: the picture by its address, 'Saved photo', how to change it, Replace and Remove
error: the reason in RED as an alert, and 'Try another photo'
what is printed is escaped (a tag in a message or a file name is text)
every button is off when the field is disabled (a save is on its way)
the picture for the ID card: the preview of a ready photo, the address of a saved one, nothing otherwise
the form draws the field in the Identity card, after the Name, only when a photo slot is given; the ID card shows the picture instead of the initials
the panel checks the photo in the browser before anything is sent, and sends it only AFTER the employee is saved (add and modify)
a photo chosen or removed counts as a change in Modify (the review lists it, the save button waits for it), and an 'unchanged' answer still sends it
a failed photo never undoes the save: the person is told, in words, that the employee is saved but the photo is not
the headings say who may use the tool, not only executives (non-executives can be in the list)
the real browser parts are loaded only when a photo is chosen (the face finder is a dynamic import), and the model is served from our own folder
